why.input: One input object; the only required field is non-null.
why.payload: Returns the starrable, so the client can refresh its star count and viewerHasStarred.
why.errors: Failures (not found, no permission) arrive only as top-level errors.
why.retry: Starring twice leaves one star: naturally idempotent.
why.naming: Verb first, says exactly what happens.

why.input: One input; repositoryId and title non-null, the rest optional.
why.payload: Returns the issue but not the repository, so issue counts on the repository need a refetch.
why.errors: Validation and permission failures are top-level errors only.
why.retry: A retried create makes a second issue; no idempotency key (clientMutationId is only echoed).
why.naming: Verb first and says what it creates.

why.input: One input, a typed enum for the method with a default.
why.payload: Returns the pull request (now merged) and the actor.
why.errors: Merge conflicts and failed checks surface as top-level errors.
why.retry: expectedHeadOid is optimistic concurrency: merge only the commit you reviewed; merging twice fails safely.

why.payload: Returns the parent repository, the right object for a client to refresh after a delete.
why.errors: Failures arrive only as top-level errors, untyped in the schema.
why.retry: A retry after success fails with not found: no double effect, but the client sees an error for a success.
why.naming: Verb first and names the object it deletes.

why.input: Sixteen loose, all-nullable arguments; nothing says which are needed to create vs update.
why.payload: Returns the entry, nothing about the list or media counts.
why.errors: Failures arrive only as top-level errors, untyped in the schema.
why.retry: Upsert with absolute values is safe to repeat, but creating (no id) twice is not clearly safe.
why.naming: PascalCase and 'save' hides whether it creates or updates.

why.input: Five nullable ids where exactly one is meant: a @oneOf input before @oneOf existed.
why.payload: Returns the whole favourites collection, heavy but enough to update.
why.errors: Failures arrive only as top-level errors, untyped in the schema.
why.retry: A toggle retried after a lost response undoes itself: the worst possible retry behaviour.
why.naming: PascalCase; 'toggle' hides the resulting state; setFavourite(value) would say it.

why.input: The id is nullable: deleting nothing is expressible.
why.payload: Deleted { deleted: Boolean } tells the client nothing to update its list with.
why.errors: Failures arrive only as top-level errors, untyped in the schema.
why.retry: Deleting twice is harmless, but the second answer differs from the first.
why.naming: PascalCase breaks field naming convention; otherwise clear.

why.input: One input object, all fields non-null.
why.payload: ReviewCreated has the review (and its book), but the member types are hand-rolled per outcome.
why.errors: Every domain outcome is a typed union member clients must handle.
why.retry: No idempotency key: a retry is a DUPLICATE error, not a replay (lab 4.4 fixes this).
why.naming: The 'Typed' suffix names the implementation style, not the action.
